### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

 

 

## Where we’re making news

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers
are making news around the globe. Here are some of the latest stories.

Your Global Partner in Injection Molding Solutions

# Complete Manufacturing Systems and Services for Every Industry

Founded in 1953, Husky is a global provider of injection molding systems, hot runners, mold
controllers, and proactive monitoring services, specializing in solutions for PET preform and bottle
production, food packaging applications, consumer goods, and medical device manufacturing.

The future is accelerating and industries are reconfiguring, but one truth remains: innovation
requires constant drive.

That's why Husky builds beyond the moment. We adapt systems to evolving needs. We're not just a
machine supplier. We're a technology partner defining the future of manufacturing itself.

Husky transforms factories into intelligent networks, leveraging sustainability as a competitive
advantage and embedding foresight into the systems our customers run every day. From bottles and
consumer packaging to life-saving medical devices, our solutions are built for the pressures testing
today's industries, the opportunities redefining tomorrow, and the customers whose success powers
every day.

[Explore Our Injection Molding Systems][196]
Powering Production Excellence

## Complete Injection Molding Systems for Global Industries

Husky enables the production of finished products for a diverse range of  markets, including PET
preform manufacturing for beverage producers, thinwall food containers for packaging manufacturers,
beverage and specialty closures, consumer goods for retail brands, medical and pharmaceutical
molding for healthcare applications, electronic components, and more.

[Find the Right Injection Molding Solution for Your Market][197]
[People shaking hands after deciding on the right plastics manufacturing solution]
Complete Manufacturing Solutions

## End-to-End Injection Molding Solutions

Husky offers more than just systems and equipment. As a leading plastic injection molding supplier,
we gain a full understanding of your business, how it operates, your production goals, and the needs
of your customers. We then work with you to arrive at just the right operational setup, deliver and
install it onsite, and train your team to ensure you are up and running according to your exact
specifications.

Through our [Husky Advantage+Elite™][198] service, we provide real-time proactive, predictive, and
transparent monitoring. If we recognize a decline in equipment performance, we call you to address
issues before they result in unplanned downtime. Additionally, we stay connected with you throughout
the life of your system with genuine OEM parts, technical assistance, and troubleshooting support.  

[Our Solutions][199]
[Husky technicians working on an injection molding system]
Investment that Delivers

## Why Choose Husky for Injection Molding Service and Support?

From the moment you purchase your first Husky[ injection molding system][200] to years down the
road, we are dedicated to your long-term success and will work with you every step of the way to
enable optimal performance and the lowest part costs.

Husky stands apart by providing proactive, predictive, and transparent services, along with process
and production monitoring. Our support includes extended protection and maintenance plans, machine
audits, equipment refurbishments, upgrades, and more.

[Our Services][201]
[A historical photo of Husky technicians running an injection molding system]
GET TO KNOW HUSKY

## About Us

Since 1953, Husky has led the world in plastic injection molding innovation. Supporting customers in
more than 140 countries, our worldwide network enables us to understand unique regional needs and
deliver responsive, local support wherever you operate.

[Learn More About Husky][202]
Expert Knowledge

## Industry Insights & Technical Resources

Explore Husky's library of technical insights, customer success stories, and industry updates. Our
content enables you stay informed with:
* **Technical Insights:** Industry trends and injection molding innovations
* **Application Spotlights: **Real-world customer success stories
* **Product Updates:** Latest system features and capabilities
* **Best Practices: **Operational guidance for maximizing performance

[Browse Resources to Optimize Your Operation][203]

Husky's comprehensive range of injection molding systems delivers industry-leading performance

Your Global Partner in Injection Molding Solutions

# Complete Manufacturing Systems and Services for Every Industry

Founded in 1953, Husky is a global provider of injection molding systems, hot runners, mold
controllers, and proactive monitoring services, specializing in solutions for PET preform and bottle
production, food packaging applications, consumer goods, and medical device manufacturing.

The future is accelerating and industries are reconfiguring, but one truth remains: innovation
requires constant drive.

That's why Husky builds beyond the moment. We adapt systems to evolving needs. We're not just a
machine supplier. We're a technology partner defining the future of manufacturing itself.

Husky transforms factories into intelligent networks, leveraging sustainability as a competitive
advantage and embedding foresight into the systems our customers run every day. From bottles and
consumer packaging to life-saving medical devices, our solutions are built for the pressures testing
today's industries, the opportunities redefining tomorrow, and the customers whose success powers
every day.

[Explore Our Injection Molding Systems][196]
Powering Production Excellence

## Complete Injection Molding Systems for Global Industries

Husky enables the production of finished products for a diverse range of  markets, including PET
preform manufacturing for beverage producers, thinwall food containers for packaging manufacturers,
beverage and specialty closures, consumer goods for retail brands, medical and pharmaceutical
molding for healthcare applications, electronic components, and more.

[Find the Right Injection Molding Solution for Your Market][197]
[People shaking hands after deciding on the right plastics manufacturing solution]
Complete Manufacturing Solutions

## End-to-End Injection Molding Solutions

Husky offers more than just systems and equipment. As a leading plastic injection molding supplier,
we gain a full understanding of your business, how it operates, your production goals, and the needs
of your customers. We then work with you to arrive at just the right operational setup, deliver and
install it onsite, and train your team to ensure you are up and running according to your exact
specifications.

Through our [Husky Advantage+Elite™][198] service, we provide real-time proactive, predictive, and
transparent monitoring. If we recognize a decline in equipment performance, we call you to address
issues before they result in unplanned downtime. Additionally, we stay connected with you throughout
the life of your system with genuine OEM parts, technical assistance, and troubleshooting support.  

[Our Solutions][199]
[Husky technicians working on an injection molding system]
Investment that Delivers

## Why Choose Husky for Injection Molding Service and Support?

From the moment you purchase your first Husky[ injection molding system][200] to years down the
road, we are dedicated to your long-term success and will work with you every step of the way to
enable optimal performance and the lowest part costs.

Husky stands apart by providing proactive, predictive, and transparent services, along with process
and production monitoring. Our support includes extended protection and maintenance plans, machine
audits, equipment refurbishments, upgrades, and more.

[Our Services][201]
[A historical photo of Husky technicians running an injection molding system]
GET TO KNOW HUSKY

## About Us

Since 1953, Husky has led the world in plastic injection molding innovation. Supporting customers in
more than 140 countries, our worldwide network enables us to understand unique regional needs and
deliver responsive, local support wherever you operate.

[Learn More About Husky][202]
Expert Knowledge

## Industry Insights & Technical Resources

Explore Husky's library of technical insights, customer success stories, and industry updates. Our
content enables you stay informed with:
* **Technical Insights:** Industry trends and injection molding innovations
* **Application Spotlights: **Real-world customer success stories
* **Product Updates:** Latest system features and capabilities
* **Best Practices: **Operational guidance for maximizing performance

[Browse Resources to Optimize Your Operation][203]

Husky's comprehensive range of injection molding systems delivers industry-leading performance

LyondellBasell reports first quarter 2026 earnings

LyondellBasell Industries (NYSE: LYB) (the "company") announced results for the first quarter 2026.
The company reported net income for the first quarter 2026 of $125 million, or $0.38 per diluted
share. During the quarter, the company recognized $38 million of identified items, net of tax. These
items, which impacted first quarter earnings by $0.11 per share, included non-cash asset
write-downs, costs incurred for transactions and discontinued operations. First quarter 2026 EBITDA
was $568 million, or $615 million excluding identified items.

2025 sustainability report

LyondellBasell (LYB) is a leader in the global chemical industry creating solutions for everyday
sustainable living. Through advanced technology and focused investments, we are working to enable a
circular and low carbon economy. Across all we do, we aim to unlock value for our customers,
investors and society. Our sustainability approach is organized around three interconnected
elements: building on strong foundations, unlocking change and pioneering transformative solutions.

preserve and grow value through the cycle and position the company for long-term success.

Winter brings two sides of everyday life – adventure in the elements and safety at home. LYB
materials make both everyday edge and everyday comfort possible, enabling performance and protection
all season long.

## Purell medical grade polymers expand in North America

The *Purell* portfolio is available in North America. This move represents more than portfolio
expansion — it marks a strategic shift in how LYB supports one of the world’s fastest-growing
healthcare markets.

[ Learn more ][7]

## Henkel and LyondellBasell collaborate on bio-circular raw material solution

LYB and Henkel have partnered to create a renewable-based transparent plastic cage for Henkel’s WC
Frisch/Bref solid toilet rim blocks. Made through injection molding, the cage contains 30%
mechanically recycled plastics and 70% bio-circular raw materials from LYB CirculenRenew portfolio
using a mass balance approach. The collaboration highlights both companies’ commitment to
sustainable packaging innovation.

Previous Next
LyondellBasell reports first quarter 2026 earnings

LyondellBasell Industries (NYSE: LYB) (the "company") announced results for the first quarter 2026.
The company reported net income for the first quarter 2026 of $125 million, or $0.38 per diluted
share. During the quarter, the company recognized $38 million of identified items, net of tax. These
items, which impacted first quarter earnings by $0.11 per share, included non-cash asset
write-downs, costs incurred for transactions and discontinued operations. First quarter 2026 EBITDA
was $568 million, or $615 million excluding identified items.

2025 sustainability report

LyondellBasell (LYB) is a leader in the global chemical industry creating solutions for everyday
sustainable living. Through advanced technology and focused investments, we are working to enable a
circular and low carbon economy. Across all we do, we aim to unlock value for our customers,
investors and society. Our sustainability approach is organized around three interconnected
elements: building on strong foundations, unlocking change and pioneering transformative solutions.

Read more

downturns on record. Against this backdrop, LYB made deliberate business and financial decisions to
preserve and grow value through the cycle and position the company for long-term success.

[

materials make both everyday edge and everyday comfort possible, enabling performance and protection

expansion — it marks a strategic shift in how LYB supports one of the world’s fastest-growing
healthcare markets.

[ Learn more ][7]

LYB and Henkel have partnered to create a renewable-based transparent plastic cage for Henkel’s WC
Frisch/Bref solid toilet rim blocks. Made through injection molding, the cage contains 30%
mechanically recycled plastics and 70% bio-circular raw materials from LYB CirculenRenew portfolio
using a mass balance approach. The collaboration highlights both companies’ commitment to
sustainable packaging innovation.

### Get The Parts You Need

[Injection molding][28] is the quickest, most efficient method for producing high-volume plastic
components. However, this process requires significant investment in order to run in-house.
Companies that look into owning their own equipment often find the cost of machinery, factory space,
labor, and overhead is too much. That’s where we come in!

In fact, many companies use custom molders to help solve their engineering, sourcing, labor, and
equipment challenges. When you need consistent results across millions of parts, look to us to be
your trusted source. If you’re considering injection molding then you’re in the right place!

### Close-Tolerance Components Built To Your Specifications

Need custom plastic components for your device or assembly? We have you covered! With our
cradle-to-grave approach, we can help build a custom plan that allows you to manufacture
high-quality plastic parts at a reasonable cost.

### Molding Custom Components for Several Major Industries

#### Mission-Critical Components

### And more!

### Get The Parts You Need

[Injection molding][28] is the quickest, most efficient method for producing high-volume plastic
components. However, this process requires significant investment in order to run in-house.
Companies that look into owning their own equipment often find the cost of machinery, factory space,
labor, and overhead is too much. That’s where we come in!

In fact, many companies use custom molders to help solve their engineering, sourcing, labor, and
equipment challenges. When you need consistent results across millions of parts, look to us to be
your trusted source. If you’re considering injection molding then you’re in the right place!

*** Get High Volume Production Capabilities & Repeatable Results***

### Precision Mold Making and Tooling

Building a high-quality precision mold is the foundation for any successful plastics manufacturing
endeavor. Discover the difference that precision engineering and expert craftsmanship can make.
Trust Plastics Plus for your injection molding tooling needs, and let us help you achieve
unparalleled efficiency and quality to match your production needs.

### Customized Molding Solutions

Every molding project is unique. That’s why we offer tailored solutions that align with your
specific project requirements, providing flexibility in manufacturing processes, finishes, assembly
options, and packaging, resulting in a truly customized service.

[Limit switch]
[No nonsense quotes]

### Optimize Your Production Costs

Our injection molding services help you optimize the costs of production by providing efficient
material utilization, minimizing waste, and offering competitive pricing options without
compromising on quality.

### Discover How We Can Help Your Business Succeed

[Contract Manufacturing Graphic]

### Production Capacity and Scalability

With our robust production capabilities, we can accommodate projects of varying sizes and scales.
Whether you need a small batch or high-volume production, we have the capacity to meet your
requirements.
[Factory interior]

### Streamlined Processes

We offer a streamlined manufacturing process, from mold design to final production, saving you time
and effort in managing multiple suppliers and coordinating various manufacturing stages.
[Featured image: Assembly line]

### Access To A Skilled Workforce

Along with the factory’s capital resources, you gain access to the human capital as well. That means
you get access to skilled labor and experts without having to put them on your payroll.

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries

* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

From procurement to delivery, we provide end-to-end chemical distribution services tailored to your
industrial needs.

⚡

### Energy Distribution

Premium liquified petroleum gas (LPG) and liquified natural gas (LNG) supply for governmental and
private enterprises with guaranteed purity and reliability.
* Bulk and cylinder supply
* ISO-certified quality control
* 24/7 emergency support
* Flexible delivery schedules

[Learn More →][8]
🧪

### Chemicals

High-grade commodities and specialty chemicals for manufacturing and industrial applications across
multiple sectors.
* Petrochemical derivatives
* Process chemicals
* Custom formulations
* Natural Ingredients

[Learn More →][9]
🚢

### Global Logistics

Seamless international distribution network ensuring safe, timely delivery of petroleum products to
your facilities worldwide.
* Multi-modal transportation
* Real-time tracking
* Customs clearance support
* Storage and warehousing

[Learn More →][10]
Why Adeline Chemicals

## Industry-Leading Standards

Decades of expertise, global reach, and unwavering commitment to quality and safety.

01

### Certified Excellence

Certified operations ensuring the highest quality and safety standards.

02

### Global Network

Strategic partnerships across five continents for reliable supply chain management.

03

### Technical Expertise

Dedicated team of engineers and chemical specialists providing consultation and support.

04

### Sustainability Focus

Committed to environmental responsibility with carbon-neutral logistics and sustainable sourcing
practices.

Industries We Serve

## Powering Diverse Sectors

### Private Enterprises

Supporting private enterprises, large and small, manufacturing facilities and distribution
operations with reliable energy supply and raw materials.

### State-Owned Enterprises

Trusted partner for government entities requiring large-scale petroleum distribution.

### Industrial Manufacturing

Supplying petrochemical feedstocks and process chemicals to manufacturing plants and industrial
complexes globally.

### Energy Sector

Delivering fuel solutions and specialty products to power generation facilities and energy
infrastructure projects.

International Presence

## Spanning Five Continents

With partnerships, and logistics networks spanning the globe, we ensure reliable delivery wherever
you operate.

#### Asia-Pacific

China, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Taiwan

#### Middle East

Qatar

#### Europe

UK, France, Netherlands

USA, Canada, Brazil, Mexico

#### Africa

in a new way for plastic. A circular way.

# Calf Housing for Strong Starts

### The environment you choose shapes calf health, comfort, and daily care from day one.

## Founded in 1995 by Farmers

## Built Farm Tough

## Trusted by Producers Worldwide

[calf hutch]

Agri‑Plastics designs durable calf housing solutions based on real feedback from producers. From
ventilation and feeding access to long-term durability, our hutches and pens are built to solve the
everyday challenges of calf care.  

Designed for both animal comfort and farm efficiency, our systems include standard features like
roof vents, rear doors, and rear ventilation with no add-ons required. You get reliable performance
and long-term value from day one. 

As the manufacturer behind trusted calf housing systems, Agri‑Plastics delivers solutions trusted by
producers worldwide.

Because their future starts with you.

## Designed with More Built In

## Better Ventilation

Intentional airflow helps support respiratory health and a more consistent calf environment.

## More Space

Wide-Body space created by our  H-Frame design gives calves room to move and caregivers easier
access.

## Essentials Included

Key features are built into the base model, so you start with a complete calf housing setup from day
one.

## Custom Configurations

Housing can be configured with options for doors, feeding, fencing, and accessories to support
different farm layouts and workflows. 

## Find the Right Housing Solutions for Your Farm

#### Primary Housing Systems

[Calf laying in hutch]

## [Individual Housing][53]

Single-calf housing designed for individual care, clean access and daily management. 

## [Group Housing][54]

Housing designed for multiple calves, supporting group care, social development and smooth
transitions.

## [Indoor Housing][55]

Calf housing designed for barns, enclosed spaces, and controlled environments. 

## [Outdoor Housing][56]

Durable housing solutions built for changing weather and outdoor conditions.

#### Supporting Systems

## [Fencing & Confinement][57]

Options to define space, support flow, and manage calf movement.

## [Feeding][58]

Feeding options designed to support daily care, access, and consistency. 

## [Accessories][59]

Supporting components that complete the housing setup.

# Confidence in Every Calf Start

Built for comfort. Designed for daily care. Made to last year after year. 

*Because their future starts with you.*

## The Calf Index

Technical and practical insights on calf housing, environmental conditions, and calf management to
support more informed decisions on the farm.

[ Explore The Calf Index ][60]
[
][61]

### [ Group Calf Housing: Best Practices for Raising Healthy, Social Calves ][62]

[ Read More » ][63]

## Trusted by Producers Worldwide

“We really like how Agri-Plastics Indoor Calf Pens stay straight and clean. We are very impressed at
how much thought has been put into them to make them user friendly. Also, the bottle holders work
great!”
— M. Harris • Richmond, Utah
“We looked at different brands of calf hutches. We choose the Agri-Plastics EXL Hutch because of its
durability. The 3-in-One Rear Door and the side feeder door makes it easy to work with!”
— M. VanRaalte • Feewerd, Netherlands
“We really like Agri-Plastics Calf Hutches! They are built to take abuse. The calf has a lot of room
inside. The storm door option is wonderful as we live in Iowa and our winters can have a lot of
snow. These doors keep the calf hutch warm and dry.”
— Evan Bleyenberg

# Commodity Trading

Intro to Commodities, How They are Traded, and What Drives Prices
Written by [Frank Moraes][199]·Updated April 17, 2026·Cited by Forbes, The Guardian, Stanford
University [+48+ more][200]

Commodities are the raw building blocks of the world economy. From oil and corn to gold and lithium,
they trade in vast, liquid markets where price – not provenance – matters most.

## Why commodities matter

Producers hedge. Traders speculate. Consumers – from airlines to bakeries – lock in costs. Learning
how these markets work helps investors ride cycles and avoid hype.

**Quick fact:** In 2024 futures contracts worth *US $28 trn* changed hands on the CME alone.

## Major categories

Most commodities fall into four baskets:
* **Agriculture** – corn, coffee, wheat
* **Energy** – crude oil, natural gas, gasoline
* **Metals** – gold, copper, aluminium
* **Environmental & Emerging** – carbon credits, cryptocurrencies

### Agricultural highlights

Corn feeds livestock and, increasingly, cars. Coffee supplies hinge on a handful of tropical
producers. Wheat still provides a fifth of the planet’s calories.

Only **five** countries grow two‑thirds of the world’s coffee. Weather in Brazil can jolt global
prices overnight.

### Energy movers

Oil remains the economy’s lifeblood, but gas is the swing fuel for power grids. Traders watch US
shale rig counts, OPEC quotas and LNG cargo flows.

### Metals in demand

Gold is insurance against turmoil, copper the wiring of the energy transition. Prices move with real
rates, construction data and Chinese demand.

### Cryptocurrencies

[Bitcoin][229], Ethereum and their peers trade like digital commodities – scarce, fungible and prone
to booms and busts.

## What moves prices?
* **Growth:** Rising GDP means more steel, beef and fuel.
* **Dollar strength:** Commodities are priced in greenbacks; a stronger dollar often pushes prices
  down.
* **Substitution:** High sugar prices spur demand for corn syrup.
* **Weather & shocks:** Droughts lift grain prices; wars disrupt energy flows.

## How to gain exposure
1. **Physical ownership:** bullion or delivered barrels (rare for retail traders).
2. **Equities/Bonds:** buy miners, drillers or processors.
3. **Futures & options:** highly leveraged options.
4. **ETFs & ETCs:** one‑click baskets of futures or stored metals.
5. **[CFDs][230]:** leveraged derivatives that track commodity prices, without owning the underlying
   asset.
6. **[Prediction Markets][231]:** trade the probability of real-world events that can move commodity
   prices via platforms like [Plus500 Futures][232].

**IMPORTANT:** CFDs are not available in the USA.

# Commodity Trading

Intro to Commodities, How They are Traded, and What Drives Prices
Written by [Frank Moraes][199]·Updated April 17, 2026·Cited by Forbes, The Guardian, Stanford
University [+48+ more][200]

Commodities are the raw building blocks of the world economy. From oil and corn to gold and lithium,
they trade in vast, liquid markets where price – not provenance – matters most.

## Why commodities matter

Producers hedge. Traders speculate. Consumers – from airlines to bakeries – lock in costs. Learning
how these markets work helps investors ride cycles and avoid hype.

**Quick fact:** In 2024 futures contracts worth *US $28 trn* changed hands on the CME alone.

## Major categories

Most commodities fall into four baskets:
* **Agriculture** – corn, coffee, wheat
* **Energy** – crude oil, natural gas, gasoline
* **Metals** – gold, copper, aluminium
* **Environmental & Emerging** – carbon credits, cryptocurrencies

### Agricultural highlights

Corn feeds livestock and, increasingly, cars. Coffee supplies hinge on a handful of tropical
producers. Wheat still provides a fifth of the planet’s calories.

Only **five** countries grow two‑thirds of the world’s coffee. Weather in Brazil can jolt global
prices overnight.

### Energy movers

Oil remains the economy’s lifeblood, but gas is the swing fuel for power grids. Traders watch US
shale rig counts, OPEC quotas and LNG cargo flows.

### Metals in demand

Gold is insurance against turmoil, copper the wiring of the energy transition. Prices move with real
rates, construction data and Chinese demand.

### Cryptocurrencies

[Bitcoin][229], Ethereum and their peers trade like digital commodities – scarce, fungible and prone
to booms and busts.

## What moves prices?
* **Growth:** Rising GDP means more steel, beef and fuel.
* **Dollar strength:** Commodities are priced in greenbacks; a stronger dollar often pushes prices
  down.
* **Substitution:** High sugar prices spur demand for corn syrup.
* **Weather & shocks:** Droughts lift grain prices; wars disrupt energy flows.

## How to gain exposure
1. **Physical ownership:** bullion or delivered barrels (rare for retail traders).
2. **Equities/Bonds:** buy miners, drillers or processors.
3. **Futures & options:** highly leveraged options.
4. **ETFs & ETCs:** one‑click baskets of futures or stored metals.
5. **[CFDs][230]:** leveraged derivatives that track commodity prices, without owning the underlying
   asset.
6. **[Prediction Markets][231]:** trade the probability of real-world events that can move commodity
   prices via platforms like [Plus500 Futures][232].

**IMPORTANT:** CFDs are not available in the USA.

At E & T Plastics, we offer comprehensive [plastic distribution][161] for a wide range of plastic

### Acrylic Sheets

Our [transparent acrylic sheets][162] are ideal for a wide range of applications. Known for their
durability and versatility, our transparent acrylic sheet materials are crafted to meet the highest
standards of quality and reliability.

### Laser Cutting Services

E & T Plastics is acknowledged as a leader in laser cutting services for over 20 years. [Our
powerful CO2 lasers][163] can cut component parts with details in acrylic that routers simply cannot
match. With cutting power up to 2000 Watts, we can cut heavy gauge acrylic up to 1” thick. Our
lasers leave a beautiful, brilliant, highly polished edge even on parts with intricate detail. In
fact, even internal cutouts and holes achieve a high luster.

### Additional Services

[Our saw cutting services][164] enable us to cut your parts with precision accuracy, ensuring each
piece meets your exact specifications.

We also have Polishing services which add the finishing touch to your parts with the beauty of a
highly polished edge, enhancing both aesthetics and functionality.

We also offer CNC Routing with our six multi-head CNC routers equipped with tool-changing
capabilities, we guarantee precise fabrication of your designs. This advanced technology allows us
to handle complex projects efficiently and deliver high-quality results.

same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and

innovation to market adoption.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

# Custom plastic tanks, pipework, and process equipment.

Industrial Plastics has fabricated custom plastic tanks, pipework and process components in Brisbane
since 1971. We are ISO 9001:2015 certified by SGS, and our welders are qualified to the German DVS
2207 standard — significantly more stringent than minimum AS/NZS requirements.
[Get Engineer Quote][102]
[Home]

## CUSTOM TANK FABRICATION

HDPE, polypropylene and PVDF tanks from 2,000 L to 110,000 L+. Chemical storage, dosing day tanks,
food-grade vessels, secondary containment. Built to AS/NZS 4766 and DVS 2207. Trusted by Rio Tinto,
Veolia and Goodman Fielder. 

[Read More][103]

## PIPEWORK

Plastic pipework designed, fabricated and installed. HDPE up to 1,200 mm, plus PP, PVDF and PVC. DVS
2207 butt-welding and electrofusion. SiteReady spool service cuts shutdown duration 30 to 60%. Rio
Tinto, BHP, Origin Energy. 

[Read More][104]
[Home]
[Home]

## CUSTOM INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL FABRICATION

Bunds, ducting, machine guards, OEM components, signage substrates and displays. CNC routing,
welding, line bending, machining and assembly under ISO 9001, certified by SGS. From your drawings
or ours, at our Hemmant, Brisbane workshop since 1971. 

[Read More][105]

## About Industrial Plastics

**Industrial Plastics has fabricated custom plastic tanks, pipework and process components in
Brisbane since 1971. We are ISO 9001:2015 certified by SGS, and our welders are qualified to the
German DVS 2207 standard, significantly more stringent than minimum AS/NZS requirements.**

From our current workshop in Hemmant, our process and project engineers spec, draw and fabricate for
blue-chip clients across mining, water treatment, food processing and energy, including Rio Tinto,
BHP, Veolia, Goodman Fielder and Origin Energy. Every job ships with documented weld records,
material certificates and ITPs. We focus on engineer-specified custom work; for off-the-shelf items,
see our product catalogue.

[Read More][106]
[Home]

**ISO 9001** certified by SGS · Manufactured to **Germa

# Custom plastic tanks, pipework, and process equipment.

Industrial Plastics has fabricated custom plastic tanks, pipework and process components in Brisbane
since 1971. We are ISO 9001:2015 certified by SGS, and our welders are qualified to the German DVS
2207 standard — significantly more stringent than minimum AS/NZS requirements.
[Get Engineer Quote][102]
[Home]

## CUSTOM TANK FABRICATION

HDPE, polypropylene and PVDF tanks from 2,000 L to 110,000 L+. Chemical storage, dosing day tanks,
food-grade vessels, secondary containment. Built to AS/NZS 4766 and DVS 2207. Trusted by Rio Tinto,
Veolia and Goodman Fielder. 

[Read More][103]

## PIPEWORK

Plastic pipework designed, fabricated and installed. HDPE up to 1,200 mm, plus PP, PVDF and PVC. DVS
2207 butt-welding and electrofusion. SiteReady spool service cuts shutdown duration 30 to 60%. Rio
Tinto, BHP, Origin Energy. 

[Read More][104]
[Home]
[Home]

## CUSTOM INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL FABRICATION

Bunds, ducting, machine guards, OEM components, signage substrates and displays. CNC routing,
welding, line bending, machining and assembly under ISO 9001, certified by SGS. From your drawings
or ours, at our Hemmant, Brisbane workshop since 1971. 

[Read More][105]

## About Industrial Plastics

**Industrial Plastics has fabricated custom plastic tanks, pipework and process components in
Brisbane since 1971. We are ISO 9001:2015 certified by SGS, and our welders are qualified to the
German DVS 2207 standard, significantly more stringent than minimum AS/NZS requirements.**

From our current workshop in Hemmant, our process and project engineers spec, draw and fabricate for
blue-chip clients across mining, water treatment, food processing and energy, including Rio Tinto,
BHP, Veolia, Goodman Fielder and Origin Energy. Every job ships with documented weld records,
material certificates and ITPs. We focus on engineer-specified custom work; for off-the-shelf items,
see our product catalogue.

[Read More][106]

## Why Choose Laird Plastics as Your Industrial Plastic Supplier

Since 1970, Laird Plastics has been North America's trusted partner for businesses requiring
high-quality plastic materials and expert fabrication services. As the continent's largest
independent plastic distributor, we combine the personalized service of a local supplier with the
buying power, inventory depth, and technical expertise of a national organization serving aerospace,
medical, manufacturing, construction, and signage industries.

rods, tubes, and films. From standard materials like acrylic and polycarbonate to specialty
engineering plastics like PEEK, PTFE, and Ultem, we stock materials from the world's leading
manufacturers including Plaskolite, SABIC, Röhm, and Evonik. Every location provides immediate
access to common materials with overnight shipping available for specialized requirements.

guidance on material selection, compliance requirements, and application engineering. We understand
the specific demands of aerospace, medical, food processing, and other regulated industries, helping
you select materials that meet FDA, NSF, UL, ASTM, and other critical certifications. Technical
consultations are complimentary at all locations.

components including laser cutting, routing, thermoforming, plastic welding, and close-tolerance
machining. From prototype quantities to production runs, we provide value-added services that reduce
your production time and costs. Same-day cutting service available on stock materials at most
locations.

## Comprehensive Plastic Materials Inventory

From commodity plastics to high-performance engineering polymers, Laird Plastics maintains North
America's most extensive selection of plastic sheets, rods, tubes, and films. Our inventory spans
every application from aerospace components to marine fabrication, architectural glazing to food
processing equipment.

[Clear acrylic and polycarbonate sheets for displays and safety applications]

### Clear & Transparent Plastics

Our acrylic sheets and polycarbonate panels dominate transparent plastic applications. Cast acrylic
offers crystal clarity for museum displays, aquariums, and architectural glazing, while
polycarbonate provides 250 times the impact resistance of glass for machine guards, safety shields,
and bulletproof barriers. Available in clear, tinted, and UV-stabilized formulations from
manufacturers like Plaskolite, SABIC, and Röhm. PVC sheets offer economical transparency with
excellent chemical resistance for industrial applications. [Shop Clear Plastics][79]

[High-performance PEEK, Ultem, and engineering plastic materials]

### Engineering Plastics

High-performance engineering plastics including PEEK, Ultem, Torlon, acetal (Delrin), and nylon
deliver exceptional mechanical properties for demanding applications. PEEK withstands continuous
temperatures to 480°F while maintaining dimensional stability in aerospace and semiconductor
environments. Acetal offers low friction for gears and bearings. PTFE (Teflon) provides chemical
inertness and non-stick properties for chemical processing. These materials meet stringent aerospace
(AS9100), medical (USP Class VI), and industrial specifications. [Shop Engineering Materials][80]

[HDPE and UHMW polyethylene sheets for marine and industrial use]

### Polyethylene Materials

HDPE sheet provides superior chemical resistance, moisture resistance, and impact strength for
cutting boards, chemical tanks, and marine applications. UHMW (Ultra-High Molecular Weight
polyethylene) features self-lubricating properties ideal for wear strips, chute liners, and conveyor
components. Both materials are FDA compliant for food contact and USDA approved for food processing
environments. King StarBoard marine-grade HDPE resists saltwater corrosion and UV degradation for
boat fabrication and dock construction. [Shop Polyethylene][81]

[Expanded PVC foam boards and specialty plastic substrates for signage]

### Specialty & Substrate Materials

Expanded PVC foam boards, ACM (aluminum composite material) panels, and corrugated plastic sheets
serve signage, display, and architectural markets. King ColorBoard and Sintra provide lightweight,
weather-resistant substrates for outdoor signage with vibrant color retention. G-10 fiberglass
laminates offer high strength-to-weight ratios for electrical insulation and structural
applications. Static-dissipative and conductive plastics protect sensitive electronics in cleanroom
and ESD-controlled manufacturing environments. [Shop Specialty Plastics][82]

[King StarBoard marine-grade HDPE for boat and dock construction]

### Marine & Outdoor Materials

Marine-grade plastics engineered for saltwater exposure, UV stability, and extreme weather
conditions. King StarBoard HDPE is the industry standard for boat fabrication, dock construction,
and coastal applications, offering superior resistance to rot, delamination, and marine organism
attachment. UV-stabilized polycarbonate and acrylic maintain clarity and strength in outdoor
installations. These materials comply with marine industry standards and resist degradation in harsh
environments where traditional materials fail. [Shop Marine Plastics][83]

[FDA approved food-grade HDPE and plastic materials for food processing]

### Food-Grade & FDA Compliant

FDA-approved materials meeting 21 CFR 177 requirements for direct food contact include HDPE cutting
boards, UHMW conveyor components, polypropylene food containers, and NSF-certified materials for
commercial kitchens and food processing facilities. These plastics resist bacterial growth,
withstand commercial sanitization cycles, and maintain compliance with USDA and FDA regulations.
Available in natural colors and thicknesses suitable for cutting surfaces, food processing
equipment, and packaging applications. [Shop Food-Grade Plastics][84]

## FAQs

### Where can I get product & price information?

Upload you drawing in app.madearia.com or e-mail, we will contact you after upon receipt your mail.

### How soon can I get samples and how much the fee?

Depending on your specific project, it usually takes 7 to 15 days. the fee depends on the product
drawing, and the fee will be returned to your bulk order.

### How to enjoy the OEM services?

Usually, base on your design drawings or original samples, we give some technical proposals and a
quotation to you, after your agreement, we produce for you.

### Can you make machining parts based on our samples?

Yes, we can make measurements based on your samples to make drawings for machining parts making.

### Do your materials and processes comply with RoHS, REACH, or other EU standards?

Yes, all our raw materials and manufacturing processes fully comply with RoHS, REACH and relevant EU
regulatory standards.

### What if my parts do not meet the required specifications？

If the finished parts fail to meet your specs, we will revise or remanufacture them free of charge
at our cost until they match your requirements.

## FAQs

### Where can I get product & price information?

Upload you drawing in app.madearia.com or e-mail, we will contact you after upon receipt your mail.

### How soon can I get samples and how much the fee?

Depending on your specific project, it usually takes 7 to 15 days. the fee depends on the product
drawing, and the fee will be returned to your bulk order.

### How to enjoy the OEM services?

Usually, base on your design drawings or original samples, we give some technical proposals and a
quotation to you, after your agreement, we produce for you.

### Can you make machining parts based on our samples?

Yes, we can make measurements based on your samples to make drawings for machining parts making.

### Do your materials and processes comply with RoHS, REACH, or other EU standards?

Yes, all our raw materials and manufacturing processes fully comply with RoHS, REACH and relevant EU
regulatory standards.

### What if my parts do not meet the required specifications？

If the finished parts fail to meet your specs, we will revise or remanufacture them free of charge
at our cost until they match your requirements.

## Experts in Custom Packaging Design: Containers, Pallets, and Trays

Whether your product is big or small, delicate or uniquely shaped, getting it safely delivered to
the final destination is critical. That is where Peninsula Plastics comes in! Home of TUFF DUNNAGE®
solutions and the leader in “Advanced Freight Protection Technology” we offer first-in-class
solutions to all your challenging packaging needs.

Established in 1980, Peninsula Plastics specializes in manufacturing rugged plastic containers,
pallets, and trays.

No matter the challenge, Peninsula Plastics has a robust inventory of ready-to-go solutions. Each is
designed to let you push, pull, stack, store, and transport your most precious cargo across the
country, carefully and damage-free.

Struggling to find a packaging solution that safely encapsulates products with specific dimensions
and sizes? That’s okay, we can build it! We offer custom plastic packaging design solutions to meet
your exact specifications and needs.

[FIND PRODUCTS][55]

## What Sets Us Apart

### Twin Sheeting

With twin sheet thermoforming two sheets are formed simultaneously over separate molds and then
bonded together.

[Learn more about Thermoforming ][56]

[Award icon][Award icon]

### Quality Guaranteed

Our expert thermoforming manufacturing team oversees all aspects of production from the initial
concept to the final steps in production. This hands-on, in-house process ensures quality every step
of the way.

[See our certifications ][57]

[Hammer icon][Hammer icon]

### Durability & Longevity

Our TUFF DUNNAGE® solutions are built to last and are made with recycled plastic! Whether standard
or custom, our packaging is made for long-term reuse.

[Learn more about TUFF DUNNAGE® ][58]

[Recycle icon][Recycle icon]

### Sustainable Solutions

Through our Buyback Program we help customers reduce waste and implement closed-loop packaging
systems that support environmental goals.

# Welcome to Plas Mec

## Your partner in Mixing Systems for Plastic and Powder Coatings

PLAS MEC is a 100% ITALIAN company, founded in 1967 and specialized in the production of equipment
and accessories for mixing various plastic materials such as PVC, PE, PP, ABS, as well as technical
and special polymers such as TPE, PA, PC, PU, PET, PTFE, among others. In addition, PLAS MEC deals
with resins for powder coatings, wood-plastic composites, masterbatches, additives, pigments and
thermoplastic rubber.

# Custom Thermoforming for Healthcare, Food, and Consumer Products

### Let’s Shape Your Next Packaging Solution

With eight strategic locations, Plastic Ingenuity is the largest custom thermoformer in North
America. Our experience, global reach, and genuine dedication to our customers allow us to bring
your packaging vision to life, scale your product, and create a partnership that lasts beyond your
product’s lifecycle.

[Custom Thermoforming by Plastic Ingenuity]
[Plastic Ingenuity Custom Thermoforming]

## What we do

###### We’re the Whole Package

From concept to final product, we do everything in house. That means you have the assets you need to
support your solution end-to-end without the hassle and downtime that comes with outsourcing these
capabilities. Our team of experts will work with you to understand your goals, prototype your
vision, and create a best-in-class package that’s market-ready in no time.

[ Learn About Our Capabilities ][27]

## Industries we serve

###### We’re Experts in Your Industry

Since our start in 1972, we’ve seen the challenges, changes, and trends unique to your industry.
Whether it’s food, healthcare, or consumer goods, you can rely on your Plastic Ingenuity team to
guide you to a thermoforming solution that anticipates and solves for current and future needs.

[Custom thermoformed food packaging]
Food

We create custom packaging solutions that help our customers gain better shelf presence, prevent
food spoilage and contamination, and evolve to meet sustainability standards. And we do it with
speed in mind, aiming to get your package on the market and into your consumers’ hands faster.

[ Learn More ][28]
[Custom medical device packaging]
Healthcare

With deep knowledge of evolving requirements and unparalleled technical expertise, we create
innovative thermoformed solutions for the medical device, diagnostic, and pharmaceutical markets. We
aim to help you accelerate development, simplify manufacturing, and mitigate risk to bring new
therapies to patients safely.

[ Learn More ][29]
[Custom consumer goods packaging for Shark VacMop]
Consumer Goods

Maybe you’re launching a new product or evolving existing packaging to meet new consumer trends.
Whatever your challenge, our team of experts will help you create an innovative solution while
keeping customer appeal, security, and sustainability top of mind.

[ Learn More ][30]

## More Than Plastic & Packaging

Yes, we’re experts in thermoforming but we’re also dedicated engineers, innovative problem-solvers,
and great listeners. When you work with Plastic Ingenuity, you get an extension of your team
committed to your business’s success.
* [Orange lightbulb icon]
  Innovative Problem Solving
  
  At Plastic Ingenuity, we think strategically about the markets we serve, where trends are heading,
  and how our packaging solutions can creatively anticipate and solve future challenges.
* [Orange stop watch icon]
  Speed-to-Market
  
  We create our own machines, extrude our own materials, and take care of everything in house. That
  means a more streamlined process that helps get your package to market faster.
* [Orange partnerships icon]
  Long-Lasting Partnerships
  
  We treat your project as our project and strive to be an extension of your team. We’re here to
  support and guide you, offer our expertise and industry knowledge, and create a packaging solution
  and partnership that lasts.
* [1 Day Calendar Icon]
  Just a Phone Call Away
  
  It’s not often an issue may arise, but rest assured, we’ve got your back. It’s our commitment to
  our customers to be on-site within 24 hrs. Providing you the support you not only expect, but also
  deserve.
* [Custom Wheel Icon]
  All Custom, All the Time
  
  All we do is custom thermoformed solutions. So, when you come to us with a challenge, know that
  while your solution is unique, we’ve done this time and time again.
* [Plant Growing Icon]
  Experience from a Lifetime of Practice
  
  You’re in good hands when you trust your custom packaging solution to Plastic Ingenuity. In fact,
  our engineers have an average tenure of 25+ years, bringing all that experience to your custom
  solution.

# Custom Thermoforming for Healthcare, Food, and Consumer Products

### Let’s Shape Your Next Packaging Solution

With eight strategic locations, Plastic Ingenuity is the largest custom thermoformer in North
America. Our experience, global reach, and genuine dedication to our customers allow us to bring
your packaging vision to life, scale your product, and create a partnership that lasts beyond your
product’s lifecycle.

[Custom Thermoforming by Plastic Ingenuity]
[Plastic Ingenuity Custom Thermoforming]

## What we do

###### We’re the Whole Package

From concept to final product, we do everything in house. That means you have the assets you need to
support your solution end-to-end without the hassle and downtime that comes with outsourcing these
capabilities. Our team of experts will work with you to understand your goals, prototype your
vision, and create a best-in-class package that’s market-ready in no time.

[ Learn About Our Capabilities ][27]

## Industries we serve

###### We’re Experts in Your Industry

Since our start in 1972, we’ve seen the challenges, changes, and trends unique to your industry.
Whether it’s food, healthcare, or consumer goods, you can rely on your Plastic Ingenuity team to
guide you to a thermoforming solution that anticipates and solves for current and future needs.

[Custom thermoformed food packaging]
Food

We create custom packaging solutions that help our customers gain better shelf presence, prevent
food spoilage and contamination, and evolve to meet sustainability standards. And we do it with
speed in mind, aiming to get your package on the market and into your consumers’ hands faster.

[ Learn More ][28]
[Custom medical device packaging]
Healthcare

With deep knowledge of evolving requirements and unparalleled technical expertise, we create
innovative thermoformed solutions for the medical device, diagnostic, and pharmaceutical markets. We
aim to help you accelerate development, simplify manufacturing, and mitigate risk to bring new
therapies to patients safely.

[ Learn More ][29]
[Custom consumer goods packaging for Shark VacMop]
Consumer Goods

Maybe you’re launching a new product or evolving existing packaging to meet new consumer trends.
Whatever your challenge, our team of experts will help you create an innovative solution while
keeping customer appeal, security, and sustainability top of mind.

[ Learn More ][30]

## More Than Plastic & Packaging

Yes, we’re experts in thermoforming but we’re also dedicated engineers, innovative problem-solvers,
and great listeners. When you work with Plastic Ingenuity, you get an extension of your team
committed to your business’s success.
* [Orange lightbulb icon]
  Innovative Problem Solving
  
  At Plastic Ingenuity, we think strategically about the markets we serve, where trends are heading,
  and how our packaging solutions can creatively anticipate and solve future challenges.
* [Orange stop watch icon]
  Speed-to-Market
  
  We create our own machines, extrude our own materials, and take care of everything in house. That
  means a more streamlined process that helps get your package to market faster.
* [Orange partnerships icon]
  Long-Lasting Partnerships
  
  We treat your project as our project and strive to be an extension of your team. We’re here to
  support and guide you, offer our expertise and industry knowledge, and create a packaging solution
  and partnership that lasts.
* [1 Day Calendar Icon]
  Just a Phone Call Away
  
  It’s not often an issue may arise, but rest assured, we’ve got your back. It’s our commitment to
  our customers to be on-site within 24 hrs. Providing you the support you not only expect, but also
  deserve.
* [Custom Wheel Icon]
  All Custom, All the Time
  
  All we do is custom thermoformed solutions. So, when you come to us with a challenge, know that
  while your solution is unique, we’ve done this time and time again.
* [Plant Growing Icon]
  Experience from a Lifetime of Practice
  
  You’re in good hands when you trust your custom packaging solution to Plastic Ingenuity. In fact,
  our engineers have an average tenure of 25+ years, bringing all that experience to your custom
  solution.

[Welcome to Plastic Ingenuity Video]
[Icon Play]
[Woman sorting through recyclables at recycling center]

In today’s sustainability-focused world, it’s important to understand how we can better contribute
to a circular economy within the plastic and packaging industries. At Plastic Ingenuity, we’re
equipped with in-house sustainability experts and a team dedicated to understanding and navigating
circularity best practices. We’re here as guides, consultants, and innovators to help you meet your
current and future initiatives.

[ More on Sustainability ][31]

Plastic SCM was acquired by Unity in 2020 and is now a part of Unity DevOps, a modular solution from
Unity Gaming Services. Unity DevOps is a tool specifically tailored for the rigors of game
development, and gives users access to Version Control, Build Automation, and our upcoming Artifact
Center component.

## Introducing Unity DevOps

Implement DevOps best practices for game development and 3D projects. Iterate faster, collaborate
better in the cloud, and eliminate useless tasks and crunch. Unity DevOps improves game development
pipelines by automating manual processes.

[ Explore Unity DevOps ][5] [ Contact Us ][6]

“Plastiko Inc. was founded in 2008 in St. Louis, MO with manufacturing and sustainability in mind.”

[Plastic-Recycling-Lab-United-States-Consulting]

MISSION-DRIVEN

## Working in all markets where thermoplastics are used.

While it began as regional sales in the Midwest, it quickly expanded in North America to serve more
customers with concentrates and specialty additives. Today, Plastiko Purchases, Formulates, and
Distributes. The company continues to earn double digit growth each year as more manufacturers look
to recycled plastic in new products.

## Buy, Formulate & Sell Plastic Material

1

### Commodity

Plastiko buys, formulates, sells and distributes product to manufacturers who utilize commodity
plastic. This type of plastic can be widely used and is frequently utilized in consumer packaged
goods.
They include: PVC (F-PVC, R-PVC) PET (PETG, PCTG) PP (HOPP, COPP) EVA PE (HDPE, LDPE, LLDPE, HMW) PS
(GPPS, HIPS)

2

### Engineering

Engineering plastics are similar to commodity plastic, but have a better mechanical and thermal
properties. Plastiko purchases, formulates and distributes plastic raw material for engineering
purposes.
They include: ABS Nylon (Nylon 6, Nylon 66, Nylon 11, Nylon 12) PBT PC SAN ASA TPE (TPV, TPO, SEBS,
TPU, COPE)

## Thermoplastic Experts

PATH TO SUCCCESS

## Our Experience In Sustainable Plastic

[Sustainable Recycled Plastic Supply Consulting]

Plastiko began working with recycled content after being approached by a food packaging company. A
fire at their extrusion facility had left them with over one million pounds of damaged and
(seemingly) unusable PS rolls. Plastiko was able to help them find new applications and pay them for
unusable material.

 

This success gave Plastiko the opportunity to establish a toll processing program for the scrap PS
and the ability to sell reprocessed resin that would otherwise be wasted by the customer. Over the
years we have taken this experience and applied it to a variety of industries. We’ve been able to
help companies seeking recycled resins and also those with excess materials.

Welcome to QTM

# California-Based Thermoplastics Distributor

[ Let's Get Started ][35]

## Resin Distribution

Founded in 1999, QTM, Inc. was established to better serve thermoplastic processors, OEMs, and end
users. Unlike the larger distribution companies that dominate today’s plastics distribution world,
we are a smaller yet aggressive plastics distribution and manufacturing partner. Our mission is to
provide personalized, efficient, and high-quality service to meet the unique needs of our clients.

As a forward-thinking company, QTM is proud to be one of California’s recycled plastic resin
suppliers committed to sustainable plastic resin solutions. We offer a range of recycled plastic
resins and eco-friendly materials to support your environmental goals without compromising
performance or quality.

[ Learn More About QTM ][36]
[ Why Choose QTM? ][37]

## What Makes Us Different?

We Care We Think Outside The Box We Are Experienced

We focus on building strong relationships and providing tailored solutions that larger companies
can’t match. 

We excel at developing unique, creative solutions to complex issues. Free from the constraints of
big-box company thinking, our singular goal is to work collaboratively with our customers to get the
job done right. 

Our sales and technical support team comprises engineers and scientists with more than 125 years of
combined experience in the materials marketplace. We provide comprehensive support, from material
selection and processing guidelines to on-site technical support and quality control. Your success
is our success. 

## Our Services

### High-Quality Material

We offer a wide range of thermoplastic materials to meet diverse industry needs. We are a premier
plastic resin supplier and wholesale plastic distributor providing engineering plastics distribution
and high-performance plastic resins. 

[ Learn More ][38]

### Just-in-Time Shipment

We provide JIT shipment services to minimize your inventory costs and ensure you have the materials
you need when you need them.

[ Learn More ][39]

### Technical Staff

Our experienced technical staff is available to assist with custom polymer compounds and specialty
plastic resin solutions, ensuring the optimal performance of your products.

[ Learn More ][40]

### Sustainable Solutions

As a forward-thinking company, we offer sustainable plastic resin solutions and recycled plastic
resin options to support your environmental goals.

[ Learn More ][41]

#### Strategically Located Resin Distribution

Our central location in Placentia, CA, ensures efficient distribution and timely delivery, making us
a reliable industrial plastic materials supplier for Southern California and beyond. 

#### Woman-Owned Business

We are proud to be a Woman-Owned Business certified by WBENC and WOSB. We are committed to fostering
diversity and inclusion in the industry. 

#### Our Customers Come First

Explore our services and see how QTM can help your business thrive. Contact us today for more
information!

Founded in 1999, QTM, Inc. was established to better serve thermoplastic processors, OEMs, and end
users. Unlike the larger distribution companies that dominate today’s plastics distribution world,
we are a smaller yet aggressive plastics distribution and manufacturing partner. Our mission is to
provide personalized, efficient, and high-quality service to meet the unique needs of our clients.

As a forward-thinking company, QTM is proud to be one of California’s recycled plastic resin
suppliers committed to sustainable plastic resin solutions. We offer a range of recycled plastic
resins and eco-friendly materials to support your environmental goals without compromising
performance or quality.

[ Learn More About QTM ][36]
[ Why Choose QTM? ][37]

## What Makes Us Different?

We Care We Think Outside The Box We Are Experienced

We focus on building strong relationships and providing tailored solutions that larger companies
can’t match. 

We excel at developing unique, creative solutions to complex issues. Free from the constraints of
big-box company thinking, our singular goal is to work collaboratively with our customers to get the
job done right. 

Our sales and technical support team comprises engineers and scientists with more than 125 years of
combined experience in the materials marketplace. We provide comprehensive support, from material
selection and processing guidelines to on-site technical support and quality control. Your success
is our success. 

## Our Services

### High-Quality Material

We offer a wide range of thermoplastic materials to meet diverse industry needs. We are a premier
plastic resin supplier and wholesale plastic distributor providing engineering plastics distribution
and high-performance plastic resins. 

[ Learn More ][38]

### Just-in-Time Shipment

We provide JIT shipment services to minimize your inventory costs and ensure you have the materials
you need when you need them.

[ Learn More ][39]

### Technical Staff

plastic resin solutions, ensuring the optimal performance of your products.

resin options to support your environmental goals.

[ Learn More ][41]

a reliable industrial plastic materials supplier for Southern California and beyond. 

#### Woman-Owned Business

We are proud to be a Woman-Owned Business certified by WBENC and WOSB. We are committed to fostering
diversity and inclusion in the industry. 

#### Our Customers Come First

# Quad Plus: Engineering, Control System Integration & Power Systems

[industrial electrical engineering exterior quad plus building]

Quad Plus is an international engineering company that provides electrical services including
professional engineering, industrial controls and system integration solutions, power services and
repairs to a variety of industries. With a skilled design team made up of controls, mechanical,
civil, structural, chemical, and electrical engineers, Quad Plus has extensive process knowledge
spanning from the utility pole to the motor shaft. Our team of experienced experts can meet your
needs throughout the complete engineering lifecycle.

[Contact Quad Plus Now!][66]

## **End to End Integrated Engineering Solutions for Demanding Industrial Environments**

Quad Plus is an international engineering company combining industrial control systems integration,
power distribution expertise, and equipment repair services to support critical operations around
the world. Our team of controls, mechanical, civil, structural, chemical, and electrical engineers
works across the full engineering lifecycle, from initial studies and design through commissioning,
testing, and field service. Watch this video to see how we help customers in utilities, metals, oil
and gas, and manufacturing improve reliability, safety, and performance.

**End to End Integrated Engineering Solutions for Demanding Industrial Environments**

[industrial electrical engineering control eng systems integrator giants]
[industrial electrical engineering engineering linear dark]
[automation system integration life cycle]

## The Quad Plus Difference

### Entire Lifecycle

Whether you have a new automation system build, need to upgrade your current system, or retrofit an
outdated system, our team of expert engineers can meet your needs.

### Turnkey Solutions

Our system integration team will partner with you and manage your entire project from beginning to
end and beyond. Our goal is to make the process as smooth as possible for you.

Quad Plus is an international engineering company combining industrial control systems integration,

Finding a system integrator skilled in the retrofitting of older machines or that has experience
working with unavailable or obsolete controls can be difficult. The engineers at Quad Plus have
extensive experience with processes, hardware, and programming of legacy equipment in every industry
we serve. We know how to adapt your machinery into a new automated system design, and our
commissioning process can be done in several phases by updating one part of your process at a time
and returning to production between upgrades to minimize downtime.
